thread:
nina_cs: FYI Horton Health preflight failed: audit objects not landing in their S3 bucket and snapshots show KMS AccessDenied during mount. customer worried re: go-live window.
omar_net: can you share VPC endpoint IDs, forwarder role ARN, and the bucket ARN?
nina_cs: vpce-0f1e2d3c, role arn:arn:aws:iam::309876543210:role/redwood-horton-forwarder, bucket arn:arn:aws:s3:::horton-logs-prod.
felipe_sec: AccessDenied on Decrypt usually means key policy or missing grant. any recent SCP changes?
ops-bot: smoke-run: forwarder-health=FAIL, snapshot-decrypt=FAIL (ts=2025-08-03T07:12:18Z)
omar_net: forwarder pod exec please: curl to s3 endpoint and run tcpdump for a minute to confirm traffic path. also paste vpce policy.
nina_cs: exec done (scrubbed): curl to s3 returned 200, traceroute shows hops to com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3, but flow logs show no PutObject events; vpce policy attached denies PutObject from cross-account principals.
felipe_sec: that matches. need customer to allow cross-account PutObject or add our role as a principal in endpoint policy. i'll prepare minimal key policy + endpoint policy snippets for them.
omar_net: also verify KMS grants: have them run aws kms list-grants --key-id alias/redwood/horton-logs --profile horton-admin and paste.
nina_cs: customer flagged renewal risk=medium if unresolved >48h. scheduling joint debug call for tomorrow 09:00 ET; copying AE and renewal owner.
felipe_sec: will bring a short remediation checklist: 1) vpce policy allow PutObject from forwarder role 2) ensure key policy includes cross-account decrypt for forwarder role 3) add temporary grant if they prefer not to edit policy 4) verify flow logs delivery after endpoint update.
nina_cs: thanks team. I'll attach the snippets and meeting invite and follow up with the customer.
